title: Operations center
intro: Review, track and decide in one place.
localNotice: Drafts saved only on this computer. Approvals and actions below are simulations and do not change cash, stock or payments.
empty: No connected data in this area
emptyHelp: Explore the examples or prepare a draft.
forbidden: This area is unavailable for your access.
aboutText: The interface prepares workflows. Real confirmations require server-side permissions, audit, persistence and reconciliation. Examples are not official records.
saveError: Could not save. Keep this page open and try again.
invalid: Check the values and required fields.
confirmText: This action records a simulation in this draft only. Continue?
permission: Approval requires an authorized manager or owner role.
name: Product or reference
closingHelp: Totals come from shift sales and movements. Each payment portion is reconciled separately.
receiptHelp: Enter reference, method and amount. A receipt alone does not confirm settlement. Camera reading awaits integration; this page stores no images.
bagHelp: Unique code per closing, custodian and count. Handover and second count are separate steps.
journalHelp: Sales, payment portions and movements have separate entries. Corrections reference the original and preserve history.
returnHelp: Record the issue and applicable policy. An authorized manager reviews without overriding consumer rights. The original sale is preserved.
fiscalHelp: Return, payment and tax document statuses are independent. Tax handling depends on the transaction and jurisdiction.
inventoryHelp: The company decides when to count. Staff count; an authorized manager approves. Sales during counting are included.
reservedHelp: Units reserved for offline devices are not released by counting, expiry or a screen adjustment.
auditHelp: Authorized auditors review counts, reasons and approvals. Granting and revoking access requires the server.
qualityHelp: Raw material → approved formula → production → finished batch → customer. The formula version used is preserved.
safetyHelp: Safety sheets, reports, hazards, storage and technical ownership follow each product and activity. This page does not approve formulas or replace reports.
quarantineHelp: Under review: this batch cannot be offered as available for sale.
supplyHelp: The system suggests replenishment. The buyer accepts or rejects; the supplier confirms terms and delivery.
visit: Suggest seller contact after three rejections
driverHelp: The driver checks at dispatch and delivery; the recipient records receipt. Times are agreed considering manual route stops too.
collectionHelp: Request before delivery. The supplier defines acceptance, product credit or cash and timing. Collection can accompany a new delivery; after ending the relationship, use a nearby route or agreed deadline. Return arrival is confirmed.
opportunityHelp: Compare similar size, activity, region and period using authorized aggregates. Offers and trials need both companies to accept.
consent: Aggregate sharing authorized by the companies
performanceHelp: Low sales do not imply a loss. Consider margin, tied-up capital, waste, seasonality and production time and labor.
discountHelp: Discount suggestions respect cost and defined limits. Selling at a loss requires an explicit decision; prices are not reduced automatically.
devicesHelp: Each device sells only its exclusive allocation. Local, server and cloud communication share this rule.
awaiting_origin: Awaiting source lock; destination has no credit
offlineRules: Expiry does not release stock. Retries do not duplicate sales. Old backups require revalidation. Revoked devices retain pending records for review.
networkHelp: Without a communication path there is no shared confirmation. This demonstration performs no real transfers.
reviewNeeded: Translation requires native-speaker review before production.
newCaseHelp: Start a new draft in this area? Simulation history is preserved.
exampleHelp: Replace this area’s fields with an example?
termsHelp: The system records the agreement. Delivery discrepancies open a review; it does not alter payment slips, charge Pix or promise refunds without agreement and integration.
trialHelp: Trials are optional for both companies. Space and charts support decisions; no order is placed automatically.
backupHelp: Restoration must be tested. Old data does not automatically reactivate permissions or stock allocations.
unitHelp: Quantities accept up to three decimals in the same unit. Mass and volume are not converted without approved parameters.
notMatched: The data does not match the selected payment portion
